display_long_description:
One More Delve is a physics-based VR dungeon crawler. Fight, loot, and survive in up to 3 player co-op as you delve into randomized dungeons.
# Physics-Based Combat
Engage in realistic melee combat where every slash, parry, and block matters. Feel the true weight of your weapons as you dismember your enemies.
[media]
# Upgrade Your Character
Loot new armor and weapons to configure your own playstyle. Choose from one- and two-handed swords, axes, bows, shields and spells to help you fight and explore your way towards the final boss of the dungeon.
[media]
# Social Hub Server
Between dungeon runs, relax in the social hub, interact with other players and use the materials you've gathered to craft new weapons and armor.
[media]
Join a party or beat the dungeon as a solo adventurer.
[media]

 **Talk to the developer and join the community:** Discord.gg/GC4CqRebvF
